versions.content: This service can be called during running operations. If so, an ongoing operation that generates interrupts on a wakeup capable channel like e.g. time stamping or edge counting might lead to the ICU module not being able to properly enter sleep mode. This is then a system or ECU configuration issue not a problem of this specification. SWS_Icu_00022 apply to the function Icu_SetMode.
